name: Iznatoraf (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, green at the hoist and the fly and dark purple-blue above and below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Iznatoraf (crosses on green and a tower on red).
history: Municipal flag of Iznatoraf; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
